title: IT Support Specialist
description:
We are seeking a proactive IT Support Specialist to join our team. Key Responsibilities:
- Provide first and second-line technical support to end-users for hardware, software, and network issues.
- Install, configure, and maintain computer systems, printers, and other IT equipment.
- Manage user accounts, permissions, and passwords in Active Directory.
- Troubleshoot network connectivity and basic infrastructure problems.
- Maintain an up-to-date inventory of all IT assets and document support processes.
Requirements:
- Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, or equivalent experience.
- Proven experience in a technical support or helpdesk role.
- Strong knowledge of Windows and macOS operating systems.
- Familiarity with networking protocols (TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP) and Microsoft 365 administration.
- Excellent problem-solving and communication skills.
